memory_candidates.content: In this repo, before trusting a dispatch prompt's 'VERIFIED STARTING FACTS' claim that a context/patterns/*.md file is 'NOT registered' in an extension's index-entries.json, re-run the jq query yourself against the correct path. The core extension's index-entries.json lives at agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json (one level shallower than context/index-entries.json, which does not exist) -- entries' `path` field is relative to context/. A prior dispatch's stated fact can be wrong even when phrased as freshly verified.

Four test scripts in this repo (test-reconcile-handoff-status.sh, test-resume-scan-nonconformance.sh, test-skill-base-lifecycle.sh, test-update-task-status.sh) compute REPO_ROOT via a fixed `$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../../../../.." && pwd)` (5-levels-up) walk calibrated for the source-store depth (agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/, 4 levels below repo root). This resolves incorrectly when the deployed-tree copy (.claude/scripts/tests/, only 2 levels below repo root) is invoked directly -- bash .claude/scripts/tests/run-all.sh will show these 4 as failing with paths missing the repo's subdirectory prefix. The authoritative invocation is the source-store one (bash agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/run-all.sh --quiet, run from repo root), which is exactly what verify-deploy.sh gate 8 runs. Treat a deployed-path run-all.sh failure limited to these 4 scripts as this known gap, not a regression, before investigating further.

When a plan's verification bar calls for a live `/research`/`/plan`/`/implement` slash-command smoke test but the executing agent is itself a Bash/Read/Write/Edit-only implementation subagent (no ability to invoke Claude Code slash commands), the honest substitute is a direct mechanical trace of the exact scripts/shared-blocks the target skill's relevant stage imports -- e.g. for a `--lit` Stage 4a check, run the named resolver script (literature-lit-flag-resolve.sh) followed by the directive-specific next script (literature-briefing-invoke.sh --global) exactly as the shared flow doc (lit-stage4a-flow.md) prescribes for the returned directive, and cite the grep confirming the target skill actually imports that block. This produces real output evidence without fabricating a slash-command transcript.
